Dungeon Breakout

Delete your Dungeon Breakout data

App: Dungeon Breakout
Developer: Versound Games
Contact: versoundgames@gmail.com

Dungeon Breakout has no accounts, and Versound Games runs no servers that store your data. Your progress lives only on your device. The Android app uses Google AdMob (ads), Google Play Billing (purchases) and GameAnalytics (gameplay statistics), which receive the device and usage data described in our privacy policy. Here is how to delete each part.

Step 1: Delete your game progress (on your device)

On Android, either uninstall Dungeon Breakout, or open **Settings → Apps → Dungeon Breakout → Storage → Clear storage** (wording varies by device). In the web version, clear the site data for the game's page in your browser.

  • Deleted immediately: levels and stars, coins, spell charges and unlocks, bestiary progress, daily-room results and streak, settings, and the record of purchases already credited.
  • Important: because there are no accounts, this cannot be undone. Coins and charges you bought are lost too and cannot be restored.

Step 2: Ask us to delete your analytics data (GameAnalytics)

Email versoundgames@gmail.com with the subject "Delete my Dungeon Breakout data". Because the game has no accounts, please include your device's advertising ID if you can (Android: Settings → Privacy → Ads or Settings → Google → Ads), so the data can be found.

  • Deleted: the gameplay events, device information and identifiers GameAnalytics holds for your device. We send the deletion request to GameAnalytics within 30 days of your email and reply to confirm.
  • Kept: nothing by us. We keep your email only as long as needed to complete the request. Data already aggregated into anonymous totals (for example "how many players finished level 10") cannot be traced back to you and is not deleted.

Step 3: Delete or reset your advertising data (Google)

Advertising data is held by Google, not by us. On your Android device, open Settings → Privacy → Ads (or Settings → Google → Ads) and choose Delete advertising ID (or Reset advertising ID on older versions). You can also manage Google's data at myaccount.google.com.

  • Kept: Google keeps advertising and ad-measurement data according to the Google Privacy Policy.

Purchases

Purchases are processed by Google Play. We never receive your payment details. Your order history is kept by Google, which may be required to retain it for tax and legal reasons; see your Google Play order history and the Google Payments Privacy Notice. Purchase events sent to GameAnalytics are deleted with your analytics data in Step 2.

Questions

Email versoundgames@gmail.com. More detail on what the game collects and why is in the Dungeon Breakout privacy policy.
